instruction.text: Select the person who works mainly with electricity.

feedback.end: Correct! This is Jemma the electrician. Let’s look at some of the problems she has to solve today.

instruction.text: Jemma is looking at a customer’s circuit. Why is the bulb not lit? Find the problem in the circuit.

feedback.end: Correct! The wire between the bulb and the battery is frayed, which makes it dangerous for the circuit to keep running.
Frayed wires can be very dangerous, as the electricity is not contained within the circuit. It is safest for a professional electrician to fix it for you.

atoms.a: What should Jemma do to fix the frayed wire?
b: Wrap the frayed section in sticky tape.
Put it back in the wall so no one can see it.
++Replace the frayed wire with a new one.

instruction.text: Jemma’s next customer is having problems with the siren of a toy fire engine. Find the problem in the circuit.

feedback.end: There is a break in the circuit, so no electricity can be supplied to the buzzer.
Once she reattaches the wire, she should test the circuit to make sure there are no other problems.

atoms.a: What should Jemma do to make the siren work again?
b: Swap the buzzer for a new one.
Replace every part of the circuit.

instruction.text: Jemma’s final customer is having trouble with their blender. Why is the motor not spinning? Find the problem in the circuit.

feedback.end: Correct! There is a break in the wire, so the electricity cannot flow.
It is always a good idea to ask an electrician to help with problems involving electricity. It is easy for untrained people to make dangerous mistakes.

atoms.a: What should Jemma do to make the motor work again?
b: Swap the battery for a new one.
Replace every part of the circuit.
++Replace the broken wire for a new one.
